items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon.com (AMZN), Oracle (ORCL) and Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) power the US Air Force

items.title: Banks Are Dumping AI Debt: HSBC Sold Stargate Loans at a Roughly 15% Discount. Bad News for Oracle
items.summary: Key TakeawaysHSBC sold its roughly $300 million slice of a loan for an Oracle Stargate campus at about 15% below face value. The sale is small, but it prices the risk lenders now see in Oracle’s campuses.

items.title: Broadcom Makes More AI Money Than AMD—So Why Is AMD’s Stock Crushing It?
items.summary: One chip giant books far more AI revenue, yet its stock sinks while its smaller rival soars. Investors are betting on a growth curve, but cash flow, inventory, and a December earnings date could change who looks smarter.

items.title: Fed Blames High Stock Prices Partly on “Enthusiasm for Super Intelligence.” Microsoft Has More to Lose Than Nvidia
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Fed’s Nov. 13 Financial Stability Report links high stock valuations partly to AI enthusiasm, and 87% of the market contacts it surveyed named AI as a salient risk.

items.title: How Much Of Big Tech's AI Spending Reaches Nvidia?
items.summary: You may have read that about half of each dollar Big Tech spends on AI ends up at Nvidia. Our own articles have said so too. That number is a ratio, not a measurement. Our estimate, built from what the companies report, puts the real share closer to a quarter.

items.title: Fed Warns Big Tech’s AI Exposure “May Be Substantially Larger” Than Its Balance Sheets Show. That’s a Risk for Nvidia
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Fed warns big tech’s exposure to an AI downturn “may be substantially larger” than its balance sheets show. For Nvidia, the bigger risk is its earnings estimates, since the AI firms it backs are also its customers.
